title: Inward Spiral Terrain Sweep
description: An automated planetary rover is deployed on a rectangular grid of elevation readings. To efficiently map the region, the rover must traverse the terrain in an inward spiral path starting from the top-left corner, moving right, down, left, and up, continuing inward until all grid cells have been visited and recorded.
input_format: An m x n 2D integer matrix representing terrain elevations.
output_format: A 1D array of integers containing the values traversed in spiral order.

examples.explanation: Traverses the outer boundary clockwise then visits the center element.
Traverses a 3x4 grid in a spiral order.
A single element matrix returns that element.
